title: The Mechanical Ghost
logline: Precision requires a certain kind of haunting.
story_note: This is a study of presence through absence, focusing on the machine as a living entity. It builds to the moment a gloved hand reaches into the dark internal assembly, suggesting a symbiotic relationship between man and metal. It opens on the out-of-focus jackets in clip A037_01130338_C001.

title: A Clean Slate
logline: The path to progress is paved with blue rags and patience.
story_note: A meditative look at the 'boring' parts of a dream life—the repetitive cleaning of parts that no one will ever see. The emotional peak is the slow, deliberate spread of white paste on an exhaust pipe, turning grime into a mirror. It opens on the high-angle cleaning in clip A037_01161344_C008.

title: The Silent Observer
logline: Some work is best performed under a watchful eye.
story_note: This leverages the presence of the cat to create a 'Noir' atmosphere of domestic stillness versus mechanical labor. The story focuses on the contrast between the cat’s frozen posture and the man's rhythmic wrenching. It opens on the wide shot of the cat in clip DJI_20260326122649_0003_D.

title: The Blueprint Stage
logline: The hardest part of the build is the paperwork.
story_note: This story highlights the mental load of a creator, focusing on the maintenance sheet as a sacred text. It builds to the man leaning forward on the couch, chin in hands, contemplating the invisible problems. It opens on the worksheet being placed on the table in clip A037_01201820_C019.

title: First-Person Resolve
logline: Perspective is everything when you are deep in the guts of it.
story_note: A raw, immersive sequence that follows the transition from sitting on a messy floor to putting on gear and diving into the engine. It emphasizes the tactile nature of the brand—the feeling of the glove and the weight of the tool. It opens on the first-person shot of the floor in clip DJI_20260402143402_0001_D.

title: Crushing the Shadows
logline: Clarity is something you have to build for yourself.
story_note: Taking a literal approach to the 'The Batman' aesthetic, this story is about the act of lighting the dark to see the work. The climax is the adjustment of the ring light, which casts a cinematic glow over the disassembled engine. It opens on the man adjusting the light in clip DJI_20260401182831_0007_D.

title: The Final Residue
story_note: An unexpected focus on the 'waste'—the blue coolant and the grime inside the fairings—as a badge of honor. It reframes the mess as proof of life and effort rather than something to be hidden. It opens on the overhead cleaning of the fairing interior in clip A037_01201522_C014.

title: Tactile Intelligence
logline: Your hands know the way even when your mind is tired.
story_note: A slow-burn montage of hands manipulating small, difficult parts, emphasizing muscle memory and the calm of the workshop. The turn is the man standing back and removing his gloves, signaling a quiet victory. It opens on the close-up of the valve cover in clip A037_01161329_C005.

title: The Lens Barrier
logline: The work exists whether or not it’s being watched.
story_note: A meta-commentary on the brand itself, featuring the man reaching toward the camera as if to clean the very frame we are looking through. It breaks the barrier between the creator's labor and the viewer's gaze with a gritty, physical gesture. It opens on the low-angle crouch in clip DJI_20260326122238_0002_D.

title: Vessels of Effort
logline: Space is meant to be filled, then emptied, then filled again.
story_note: This story is about the cycle of work and rest, using the couch and the motorcycle as two poles of a single life. It contrasts the stillness of the living room with the density of the engine components. It opens on the empty couch against the posters in clip A037_01201822_C022.
